q: Do you repair radiators as well as manufacture them?
a: Yes. We design, manufacture, repair and refurbish remote radiators, engine mounted radiators, diesel and gas generator radiators and special purpose radiators.

q: Which areas of Pakistan do you serve?
a: We deliver turnkey projects, commissioning and installation all over Pakistan, with workshops in Karachi and Lahore and a factory in Faisalabad.

q: Which compressor brands do you make coolers for?
a: We supply oil and air coolers for Atlas Copco, CompAir, Ingersoll Rand, Kaeser and BOGE compressors, and fuel coolers for all other generator brands.

q: Can you design the cooling circuit for my engine?
a: Yes. We design engine cooling systems and circuits, including remote radiators with fan systems for diesel and gas engines.

q: What should I send to get an accurate quote?
a: The equipment make and model, capacity or engine rating, the city where it runs, and a photo of the nameplate or existing unit. Drawings help if you have them. A short WhatsApp message is enough to start.
